title: SKATE, A SCALABLE TOURNAMENT EVAL: WEAKER LLMS DIFFERENTIATE BETWEEN STRONGER ONES USING VERIFIABLE CHALLENGES

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring the difference in accuracy (p(correct) scores) between a task-setting LLM and its competitor LLMs on verifiable Code-Output-Prediction tasks generated by the task-setting model, to determine if models inherently design questions that favor their own specific capabilities.
